per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be highly reliable and available, aiming for four nines (99.99%) uptime.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Aside from server failure the software product shall achieve 99.99% up time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should respond to user actions within five seconds for quick tasks and within eight seconds for heavier operations.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The response shall be fast enough to avoid interrupting the user's flow of thought. 90% of tasks shall complete within 5 seconds. 98% of tasks shall complete within 8 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should handle a thousand simultaneous requests now and scale to handle two thousand requests in the next release.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be capable of handling up to 1 000 concurrent requests. This number will increase to 2 000 by Release 2. The concurrency capacity must be able to handle peak scheduling times such as early morning and late afternoon hours.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should only allow access to approved company employees or external users with approved company IDs.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall ensure that only company employees or external users with company-approved user IDs may have product access. 100% of all logons shall be by either company employees or external users with company-approved user IDs.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should support multiple languages based on target markets, with a mechanism for language selection.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall allow the user to select a chosen language from one of the target market countries.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should conform to accessibility requirements such as the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA).
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall conform to the Americans with Disabilities Act.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should run in any normal HTML browser and display correctly in eighty percent of the browsers tested.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must be able to interface with any HTML browser. The product shall transmit data between the user and the product without problems. The product shall display HTML properly in 80% of all HTML browsers tested (minimum is to test 8 browsers).'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should log access attempts for audit purposes.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall create an exception log of problems encountered within the product for transmission to our company for analysis and resolution.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should maintain the same user experience during peak times, especially for core tasks like booking and checking availability.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be capable of handling up to 1 000 concurrent requests. This number will increase to 2 000 by Release 2. The concurrency capacity must be able to handle peak scheduling times such as early morning and late afternoon hours.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should have good validation on imports and a way to clean up oddities quickly.
